topAvoidableRoundTrips.description: On every graph.invoke(), PostgresSaver issues 3 sequential queries (SELECT from checkpoints, checkpoint_blobs, checkpoint_writes) to restore state before execution starts.
topAvoidableRoundTrips.avoidableRecommendation: Combine checkpointer lookups into a single joined query, or cache active thread state in Redis.

topAvoidableRoundTrips.description: After execution completes, checkpointer commits checkpoint metadata and state writes in 2-3 separate sequential INSERTs.
topAvoidableRoundTrips.avoidableRecommendation: Batch checkpointer persistence into a single transactional round trip.

topAvoidableRoundTrips.description: Controller sequentially verifies conversation exists (SELECT), verifies user exists (SELECT), and inserts user message (INSERT) before invoking the graph.
topAvoidableRoundTrips.avoidableRecommendation: Combine conversation lookup, user check, and user message insert into a single CTE (WITH ins AS ...) round trip.
